The Handicapper offered observations and the Veterinary Officer examined the gelding post-race and had nothing to report. Jockey was accompanied in the enquiry by a Jockey Coach. The rider stated her instructions were to drop the gelding in as he has been keen in the past and to ride the race as she found it. Jockey added that down the back straight, she was in behind another runner and was reluctant to come 3 wide to make her move, before eventually getting out and following a rival when making her effort 2f out. Trainer confirmed the instructions and stated that in the first part of the race the ride accorded with the instructions, but in the final 3f she felt that the rider had let the winner and the second placed runners get too far ahead. Jockey was suspended for 10 days, on dates to be notified, for failing to take all reasonable and permissible measures to obtain the best possible placing)
